findings.evidence: Host activation mutation, SDK effect settlement, Tool context append and ReAct checkpoint CAS are independent transitions; terminal effect replay skips handler, so crash after settlement can lose activation permanently.
findings.root_cause: No single durable authority/replay protocol joins activation receipt, terminal effect, tool-result progress and next-ready exposure.

conclusion.summary: Persist typed catalog-bound activation receipt in terminal effect result, deterministically reapply on execution and terminal-effect replay, and make checkpoint exposure revision sole Provider/authorization recovery authority; fault-inject all transition windows.
